description: Source code for the AGS10 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including functions for reading sensor data, initialization, and API registration.

methods.name: ags10_read
methods.description: Reads data from the AGS10 sensor over I2C, with CRC validation.

methods.name: ags10_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a sample from the sensor, validates CRC, and updates internal data.

methods.name: ags10_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the VOC measurement from internal data.

methods.name: ags10_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, checks readiness, and reads firmware version.
